searchText: Reminder! Eth2 call in 9.5 hours. Will share all the links 20 minutes before eth2 call in 15 minutes! youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sz87_i5Uy1I youtube chatbox: agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/73 zoom: https://zoom.us/j/643062977 My notes: https://gist.github.com/mratsim/b481ee7c598353298f111059d688be0c **protolambda** Doc on eth2 merkle trees and multiproofs. Speed up lookups, back a partial with it, and run multiproofs without stackframes / allocations (push for cheap ewasm execution): https://github.com/protolambda/eth-merkle-trees (Also relevant to those looking at merkle DBs, and ongoing effort to optimize MPTs in Geth) Doc on optimizations (NOT essential to interop, but useful for those that have resources to try implement them): https://github.com/protolambda/eth2-impl-design <benjaminion> I've got notes as well: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jA4H6uQvPsWYrOUGFJeQWqXzP6YUq6BFKfPYAI7_y3g/edit?usp=sharing **Joseph** Thanks to Proto for adding to https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/issues/1303
